issues.reason: The Disjunction rule is explicit — a disjunct that brings its own indefinite entity keeps that entity's (Member <witness> <class>) inside its Or branch — so a top-level (Member sk_pc_1 pc) asserts a PC exists even under the phone-only disjunct, which the sentence does not state.
Same rule and same over-assertion for (Member sk_usb_1 usb_connection): "a USB connection" is posited only by the second disjunct, so its typing must sit inside that branch.

"Additional" is an additive determiner relative to a prior discourse set, not a property predicable of an application, and the Theme is the licensed bare kind constant for a non-specific object, so there is neither a witness to carry a distributed property nor a licensed fusion — inventing one to fill the gap is barred.

The prescribed (Inheritance <kind> (can <verb>)) form would assert that applications can download — false, since the kind is the undergoer — so with no passive-capability form available the agentless-passive event with (Can e) is graceful improvisation in the gap the reviewer themself registers, and every atom it emits is true and well-typed.

gaps_confirmed: capability generic in the passive voice ("Ns can be V-ed") — the kind-level (can <verb>) property cannot express the kind as undergoer, and no alternative form is offered
new_gaps: additive / contrastive determiners ("additional", "further", "other") have no licensed carrier at all, and none whatever over an object encoded as a bare kind constant
repair_summary: Deleted the top-level (: e_pc_type (Member sk_pc_1 pc) ...) and (: e_usb_type (Member sk_usb_1 usb_connection) ...) lines and re-emitted both typings inside the second Or branch of e_dl1 and of e_dl2; the definite phone typing and the kind-level usb_connection genus stay at top level, and nothing else changed.
notes: Gap 2 is not confirmed: "via the phone" answers how, and the instruction set gives a named role priority when the PP answers where/when/how/whence/whither — the preposition-named oblique is only for PPs no named role fits, so Instrument is required and Via is not licensed here.
